name: Gemma 4 12B-it (Unified)
description: Google DeepMind's 12B encoder-free multimodal decoder (Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration): no vision or audio tower — raw 48×48 pixel patches and raw 40 ms waveform frames each pass through norms + one linear layer into the 3,840-wide embedding space. 48 layers in a [5 × sliding-window (1024), 1 × full] pattern, GQA 16/8 × 256 on sliding layers and MQA 16/1 × 512 with K = V on full layers, GELU MLP 15,360, tied 262K-vocab head with logit softcap 30; the 423M MTP drafter ships separately as gemma-4-12B-it-assistant. Numbers from config.json and the safetensors header.

summary.note: Every tensor in the checkpoint (incl. MTP / draft and vision weights), summed from the safetensors headers. Single-file checkpoint (no index). The 0.42B MTP drafter ships in a separate repo (google/gemma-4-12B-it-assistant) and is not included.

Weights multiplied per text token by the main model: lm head included; embedding (a row lookup), MTP / draft heads and vision / audio encoders excluded. The lm head is tied to the embedding, so the same 1.01B table counts here as the head.

summary.value: SWA-1024 5 : 1 full, GQA 16 q / 8 kv (sliding) · 16 q / 1 kv, K = V (full)

summary.note: Card: "text, audio, image, and video inputs"; encoder-free — patches and audio waveforms enter via linear projections.
